notes.decision: Translated 'there belongs to him' / 'he has.' The Lycopolitan form appears to be the existential ⲟⲩⲛⲧⲉ- ('there is to') + 3sg.m. suffix, with prosthetic ⲁ-. The same root ⲁⲩⲟ̄ⲛ recurs at lines 10 and 14 with the simple sense 'exists.' Here in line 5 the 3sg.m suffix supplies the dative-of-possession.
Translated 'powers united' (ⲉⲧⲧⲏⲧ = qualitative of ⲧⲱⲧ 'be joined, agreed'). The phrase characterizes the powers above and below as a single combined hierarchy over which Adam is exalted.

Read ⲧⲁⲃⲉϩ as the verb 'sealed/imprinted' (cf. ⲧⲁⲃⲉϩ 'imprint, seal' in glossary) with the demiurges and molders as subject. They sealed Adam-the-body before the radiant likeness of the icon — i.e., imprinted upon him the impression of that icon.

Translated 'is extended unto the straight-extension.' ⲥⲟⲩⲧⲁⲛⲧ = qualitative of ⲥⲟⲩⲧⲱⲛ 'be straight, extended.' ⲡⲥⲁⲩⲧⲛⲉ appears to be a substantival form on the same root, designating the ordered linear extension of cosmic structure. ⲁⲭⲙ̄ = Lyc. ⲁϫⲛ̄/ϣⲁ 'unto, until.' The line connects Adam's soul-formation to the cosmic extension and spreading of the elements.

Translated tentatively as 'with his portion, being arranged as houses.' ⲧⲉϩⲥⲁⲓ̈ϣ may be related to ⲥⲁⲓϣ in the sense of allotted measure/portion (cf. ⲥⲁⲡ 'time, lot' in glossary). ⲁⲩⲣⲏⲓ ⲍⲓ ⲟⲓⲕⲟⲥ literally 'they made house as houses' — apparently a tautological native+Greek construction expressing astrological arrangement. The cosmological sense is clear: the powers are positioned within Adam as zodiacal houses.

Translated 'divisions of the days.' ⲛⲉⲃⲉⲧⲉ is unattested in our glossary; possibly related to a Lycopolitan term for divisions/quarters/regions of time. The sequence zodiac-signs / stars / X / years strongly supports a temporal or directional division.

Translated 'take precedence in the kingship.' ⲭⲓⲟⲩⲱ = ϫⲓ-ⲟⲩⲱ (Crum 752a) 'be first, take precedence, succeed.' The bitter ones aim to exercise authority, take pre-eminence in the kingship, and abase the cosmos in Adam. Same construction recurs in line 34.

Translated 'that of the other creatures and that of the cattle.' The ⲡⲁⲛ- prefix is the relational 'that of' on plurals; ⲕⲉⲥⲱⲱⲛⲧ = 'other creatures'; ⲧⲃ̄ⲛⲁⲩⲉ = 'cattle, beasts of burden.' Adam's mind exceeds both the rational creatures and the irrational beasts.
